# Actual schema4 host timing rows

`schema4-completed-frames.csv` preserves the exact header and first two rows of
the approved Release Pipeline run `region-page-release-host-r04-pipeline` at
source c80df058, EXE SHA-256
15171b52831bbd7fe10a74009c7b4ca14cdd570d7b2c8ba303989595437b14b5.
The first interval is unavailable; the next has an exact six-span partition.
The existing `host_visible_bytes` allocation field must coexist with timing
fields without permitting unknown fields, negative allocation or invalid sums.
